title: 633. Tag Validator

examples.explanation: One outer block wraps text plus a CDATA chunk.
Nested-looking symbols inside CDATA do not break parsing.
Closing order does not match opening order.

hints: The whole string must be exactly one outer tag pair with nothing outside it.
Track open tags on a stack; CDATA sections only count when the stack is non-empty.
Tag names use 1-9 uppercase letters; CDATA opens with <![CDATA[ and closes with ]]> .
